sources.title: Introducing Sierra
sources.quote_checked: the best customer experience is not installing an app or clicking a link, but simply having a conversation. | Agents are autonomous, AI-powered software systems that can interact directly with consumers | When a Sierra agent accesses any system of record, those interactions are deterministic | can hallucinate, misrepresent your brand, and misguide your customers

sources.title: Sierra, Bret Taylor's enterprise AI agent startup, talks conversational AI
sources.quote_checked: We think that conversational AI will become the dominant form factor that people use to interact with brands | When you put an AI in front of customers, the value is a lot higher obviously, but the risks are a lot higher, too | teaching our customers about how this new type of software works

sources.title: The company using AI to change customer service
sources.quote_checked: In the future, every company will need an agent. | We converged on a technical approach that we should not be pre-training models. | The foundation models are sort of a commodity now. | AI has moved to the domain of engineering. | It will be disruptive, though. | the transition could be awkward, and that's something we need to be sensitive to

sources.title: Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor's AI startup Sierra raises $110 million from Sequoia, Benchmark
sources.quote_checked: enable every company, no matter how sophisticated or technical, to deploy

sources.title: OpenAI chair Bret Taylor says he'll recuse himself whenever there's potential overlap with his AI startup Sierra
sources.quote_checked: My job at OpenAI is really not around day-to-day operations but governance. | I took on the role because I care so much about the OpenAI mission. | I consider it one of the privileges of my career to be able to participate in that mission. | whenever there is a potential for overlap | one of the most important missions of our time
